turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Look at this example first.
I have a pen. I hear the first sound of "pen". It is "p", not a vowel sound. So I choose a.
The rule: a before most sounds, an before a vowel sound.
Correct: She eats an apple. Not correct: She eats a apple.

Try this one. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
